note: Hand-authored, the authorization-code replay rows only (#627, ADR-017 Decision 10). `quote` is verbatim from draft-ietf-oauth-v2-1-16 (2026-09-03, the revision docs/spec-pin-log.md pins) with line wrapping removed and nothing else changed. Unsealed: OAuth 2.1 is broad, and these are its first rows. The same obligation is RFC 6749 §4.1.2's and is restated by RFC 9700 §4.2.4; those specs carry their own rows, proven by the same tests.

requirements.quote: The authorization server MUST return an access token only once for a given authorization code.
requirements.applies: POST /oauth/token, authorization_code grant. The redemption spends the code by a compare-and-set (`markUsed`, `WHERE used = false`) in the transaction that issues the tokens; a second redemption, read or concurrent, issues nothing.

requirements.quote: If a second valid token request is made with the same authorization code as a previously successful token request, the authorization server MUST deny the request and SHOULD revoke (when possible) all access tokens and refresh tokens previously issued based on that authorization code.
requirements.applies: POST /oauth/token, authorization_code grant. The replay answers `invalid_grant` and revokes the refresh-token family the first redemption started, rotations included, found through `refresh_tokens.authorization_code_id`; it is recorded as `token.request_failed` with reason `code_replay`. Access tokens are self-contained JWTs and stay valid until they expire: revoking them is not possible without a per-token denylist, which the "(when possible)" of the text allows.

requirements.quote: The authorization server SHOULD NOT revoke any issued tokens when receiving a replayed authorization code that contains invalid parameters.
requirements.applies: POST /oauth/token, authorization_code grant. The replay check runs after every check of the request: client authentication, the client binding, the `redirect_uri` rule, the PKCE verifier, the DPoP key binding and the `resource` binding. A replay that fails any of them is refused for that reason and revokes nothing.
